_cursor_mode_help: joystick = turn head a little -> cursor drifts that way, face the screen -> it stops (slow, very controllable, START HERE). head = head angle sets cursor position directly (faster, needs steady head). gaze = eyes+head model from calibration.py.
_joystick_help: speed = screen-widths per second at a firm head turn (0.3 slow, 1.0 quick). deadzone = how far you must turn before it moves at all (raise if the cursor creeps while you face the screen). curve > 1 makes small turns extra gentle and big turns faster.
_head_help: Only used in head mode. Lower gain = more head movement needed but steadier.
_smoothing_help: Two filter stages (head angles, then screen position). LOWER min_cutoff = smoother but laggier (try 0.4 if still shaky). jitter_lock_px = wobble smaller than this is ignored so a parked cursor stays parked.
_click_gesture_help: mouth | blink | dwell | none.  Toggle live with m / b / d keys in the debug window.
_mouth_help: Open mouth briefly = left click. Keep it open for long_hold seconds = right click. Cursor freezes while your mouth is open.
